purpose: Provide the exogenous current national party-strength input that replaces implicit 2021 national persistence before territorialization.

required_fields.as_of: ISO-8601 evidence cutoff strictly before election outcome
required_fields.point_share: exactly one strictly-positive valid-vote share per party bucket, summing to 1 without implicit normalization

point_forecast_policy.2021_role: prior/base-rate only; never silently reused as the 2026 national answer
current_evidence: representative pre-election vote-intention evidence when methodologically admissible
post-2021 revealed electoral results with explicit scope and comparability limits
candidate/list coverage and verified high-impact defections/ralliements
other pre-election signals only when provenance and transformation are explicit
forbidden_shortcuts: derive national vote share mechanically from the current structural seat means
treat self-selected web polls as representative voting-intention polls
convert qualitative press narratives directly into arbitrary percentage-point adjustments
use 2026 election outcome or any post-election information

probabilistic_promotion_requires: an explicit national uncertainty distribution or reproducible draw generator
historical/prospective calibration evidence or an explicitly documented conservative alternative
joint integration with the conditional territorial residual library
